parameters.description: Pass `server` to ask the agent to render the `summary` Diagnostic against the negotiated locale and return it as `rendered_summary` alongside the raw structured form.

200.description: Tool invocation succeeded; body is the tool's structured response.

401.description: Unauthenticated (cookie session or API token required when the agent boots with `RUBIX_DATABASE_URL`).

post.summary:
Handler — kept at ≤20 lines. Any growth here is a smell:
domain logic belongs in `rubix-tools` (push into `probe()`),
shaping logic belongs in [`shape_response`].

get.summary:
Liveness probe. Returns 200 with a tiny JSON body — no DB, no
downstream calls. A reachable port is the entire signal.
